The '''Command Droid Mark VII''' was a model of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]]-shaped [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] produced by the [[Okara Droid Company]] at the [[Okara Droid Factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. They carried personal [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]], and were used in the factory during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Command Droid Mark VII's appear as enemies in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where they can be found inside the Okara Droid Factory on the Imperial version of Balmorra.
